title: mpeg descriptor: update Registration Descriptor (0x05)
description:
The descriptor contains a registered MPEG TS Identifier. Which full description may be found at [List of Registered MPEG TS Identifiers](https://smpte-ra.org/registered-mpeg-ts-ids).
I added displaying of a readable MPEG TS identifier and an organization name.

notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • dd9ac15f - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 0d58fa5d - mpeg descriptor: update Registration Descriptor (0x05)
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/5690/diffs?diff_id=304537774&start_sha=919f180f16f325a35ab48d91dfdf6447675915ea)

added 1 commit
  • 39e5deb9 - mpeg descriptor: update Registration Descriptor (0x05)
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/5690/diffs?diff_id=304539293&start_sha=0d58fa5dd8c45966f2a28a71cb83ac2df14ee4ab)

Hi,
Wouldn't displaying it as a 4 character string rather then an uint be enough?
Regards
Anders

Hi. I don't think so. 
Formally (according to ISO13818-1), it is an unsigned 32-bit integer value.
Also, personally, 4 character codes are not informative enough.

UPD: I am afraid the name of a registered organization is not enough to identify the following descriptors completely. But it is a useful (for app. user) reference to identify next (after 0x05) unknown descriptors.

commits_data.message:
mpeg descriptor: update Registration Descriptor (0x05)

The descriptor contains a registered MPEG TS Identifier. Which full des-
cription may be found at https://smpte-ra.org/registered-mpeg-ts-ids.
I added displaying of a readable MPEG TS identifier and an organization
name.
